name: Roo Code

surfaces.name: Roo Code (VS Code extension): skill folder

notes: Mode-specific folders (.roo/skills-<mode>/) also exist; the generic folder makes the skill available in every mode. The documentation repository was last updated on 2026-04-21.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine

docs.title: Skills (Roo Code)
docs.facts: Global ~/.roo/skills/ and ~/.agents/skills/ (%USERPROFILE% on Windows); project .roo/skills/ and .agents/skills/. Project overrides global; .roo overrides .agents at the same level; mode-specific folders override generic ones.
